question: Who was the President of Indian National Congress on 15 August 1947?
solution:
The correct answer is __**J.B. Kripalani**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• J.B. Kripalani was born on **August 24, 1888,** in Vallabhipur, Gujarat, and studied at the University of Mumbai and the University of London.
 
• He was a key figure in the Indian independence movement and a close associate of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• Kripalani served as the President of the **Indian National Congress in 1947**, during the critical period of India's independence.
 
• He became the first Speaker of the Lok Sabha from 1952 to 1957, advocating for rural development and social reform.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandit J L Nehru**

 
 
• Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru was a prominent leader in the Indian independence movement, closely associated with the **Indian National Congress** and a key disciple of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• He became the first Prime Minister of India after independence on ** **, serving until his **death in 1964**, and played a crucial role in shaping modern India's political landscape.
 
• Nehru is known for his vision of a secular, democratic nation and emphasized industrialization, scientific advancement, and education as vital components for India's development.
 
 
 
• **Rajendra Prasad**
 
 
• Dr. Rajendra Prasad served as the first President of India from **1950 to 1962**, playing a key role in the establishment of the Indian Republic.
 
• He was a prominent leader in the Indian independence movement, actively participating in the Indian National Congress and working alongside Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• Prasad was a strong advocate for education and rural development, emphasizing the importance of agriculture and self-reliance in post-independence India.
 
 
 
• **Sardar Patel**
 
 
• Sardar Patel was a key leader in the Indian independence movement, serving as the **Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Home Affairs** after independence in 1947.
 
• He is best known for his crucial role in the integration of over 500 princely states into the Indian Union, earning him the title **Iron Man of India.**
 
• Patel was instrumental in the **Kheda Satyagraha of 1918** and the **Bardoli Satyagraha of 1928,** which helped him earn the title "**Sardar" (leader) **from the farmers for his leadership in their struggles against oppressive taxation.
